svg.aria-label: Projects. OcrRoute: One API for 50+ OCR engines: smart routing, automatic fallbacks, caching, cost tracking, web dashboard and PyQt desktop app. QuizKey: Hotkey-driven AI quiz assistant for Chrome, powered by vision models (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, OmniRoute, Ollama, LM Studio…) ManyQt: Enables single-codebase support for PyQt4, PyQt5, PyQt6, PySide, PySide2 and PySide6 through a uniform API QFunnyWidgets: Funny animated Qt widgets for PyQt and PySide: switches, loaders, sliders, toasts and more, each with a personality. TheWalkingDuckTaskBar: A PyQt/PySide quacking duck that waddles across the Windows taskbar. PyQtBuilder: Builds PyQt/PySide apps on multiple platforms QRemoteDisplay: A simple RDP connector for Python, built on PyFreeRdpNative and ManyQt. MiniRDPBlocker: A lightweight tool that automatically drops unwanted RDP sessions by client IP or geolocated country. Password-protected, runs as a hidden background blocker.
